landing_intro: Create an organizer account and a dedicated workspace for your mosque, community group or organization.
landing_note: For organizations bringing people together through participation and engagement.
landing_panel_intro: Set up your account, verify your email and save your organization’s details.
feature_account_copy: Sign up, verify your email and securely return to your account.
feature_workspace_copy: Choose a name, workspace address and timezone for your organization.
feature_return_copy: Sign in to view your organizations and their saved details.
landing_status: Available now: organizer accounts, workspaces, members and groups.
landing_cta_copy: Create your account, verify your email and make your workspace yours.
story_intro: Start with your organizer account and a dedicated workspace for your organization.
saved_benefit: Your workspace, saved for your next visit.
dedicated_space: A dedicated space for your organization.
sign_out_description: You’ll need to sign in again to access your organization. Your saved workspaces will stay safe. Unsaved changes will be lost.
organizations_intro: Choose a saved workspace or create a new one.
signup_intro: Create your organizer account, then set up your organization.
signin_intro: Sign in to your saved organization workspaces.
verify_intro: Verify your email before creating an organization.
recovery_intro: Recover your account with a code sent to your email.
adult_organizer: I’m an adult authorized to set up and manage this organization.
setup_scope: Organizers can set up a workspace and manage private member records, groups and staff access.
setup_intro: Choose your organization’s name, a unique workspace address and its timezone.
slug_help: A unique name: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
authorized_organizer: I am an adult authorized to create and manage this organization.
no_payment: No payment is required to create your workspace.
workspace_saved: Your organization is saved and stays available when you sign in again.
error_description: Your request could not be completed.
replace_password_description: You will use the new password to sign in. Confirm to replace the current password.
discard_setup_description: Your unsaved organization details will be lost.
error_account_unavailable: Account services are unavailable. Please try again.
error_adult: Confirm that you are an adult organizer.
error_code: That code could not be verified.
error_authorized: Confirm that you are an adult authorized to manage this organization.
notice_account_created: Account created. Use Send a new code to verify your email.
notice_check_inbox: Check your inbox for a verification code.
notice_verified: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
notice_verified_continue: Email verified. Sign in if needed to continue.
notice_recovery: If your email belongs to an account, a recovery code has been sent.
notice_password_updated: Password updated. Sign in to continue.
notice_code_sent: A new verification code has been sent.
error_slug: Workspace address must be 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
error_refresh: Refresh the setup page and try again.
error_taken: That workspace address is already taken. Try another.
error_rate_limit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
error_workspace_unavailable: Workspace storage is not configured yet.
error_service: Account service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error_expired_code: This code has expired. Request a new code.
error_existing_email: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
page_description: Manage contacts, relationships, groups, activities and attendance for your community.
offline_description: Connect to the internet to sign in or open your organization. Your account information is never stored for offline access.
install_description: Add Himmah to your home screen for easy access. An internet connection is needed to manage your account.
install_ios: On iPhone or iPad, open Himmah in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen and Add.
install_other: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen, if available.
error_password_short: Use a password with at least 12 characters.
error_password_long: Use a password with no more than 128 characters.
error_auth_network: We couldn’t reach the account service. Check your connection and try again.
error_verification_required: Verify your email before signing in. Choose the unverified account option to request a code.
directory_roster_help: Contact records are independent of staff accounts.
directory_groups_help: Organize members into groups. A member can belong to more than one group.
directory_staff_help: Manage verified organizer access. Invitations are bound to one email address.
directory_no_matches: Try a different search or filter.
directory_get_started: Add your first record using the button above.
directory_archive_description: Change the archive status of {name}? History and group assignments will be kept.
directory_remove_description: Remove {name} from {group}? The member’s roster record will stay.
directory_access_description: This changes access to your organization. Existing saved records will be kept.
directory_invite_help: Create a private invitation link for an adult staff member. It expires after seven days and requires a verified account with the matching email.
directory_consent: I am authorized to keep this record and have any required permission or consent.
directory_discard_description: Your unsaved form changes will be lost.
directory_choose_group: Choose an active group for this member.
directory_share_help: Send this link yourself to the intended person. It is shown only now; create a new invitation if you lose it. No email has been sent automatically.
directory_copy_manual: Select and copy the link manually.
directory_join_help: Accept only an invitation you were expecting. Your verified account email must match the invitation.
directory_volunteer_access: Your volunteer access is active. Directory administration is reserved for owners and administrators.
directory_end: You’ve reached the end of this list.
directory_page_error: The next records could not be loaded. Your current list is still available.
directory_invalid_input: Check the entered details and try again.
directory_invalid_name: Use a display name of 2–80 characters.
directory_invalid_cursor: This list changed. Refresh it and try again.
directory_not_found: This workspace or record is unavailable.
directory_forbidden: You do not have permission to manage this directory.
directory_consent_required: Confirm your authorization and the required permission or consent.
directory_conflict: This record changed or access was removed. The list has been refreshed; review it before trying again.
directory_duplicate_name: That group name is already in use. Choose another.
directory_invalid_invitation: This invitation is invalid, expired, revoked or belongs to a different email. Ask the organizer for help.
directory_rate_limit: Too many changes. Wait a minute and try again.
directory_service: The directory is unavailable. Please try again.
switch_organization_help: Choose the organization you want to work with.
directory_group_members_help: Members of this group. To add someone, open Members and choose Add to group.
activities_help: Organize activities and schedule their sessions.
activities_cancel_help: Archive “{name}”? New sessions cannot be added. Existing sessions and their details stay unchanged.
activities_form_help: Set the activity details and audience, then schedule sessions. Changes apply to new sessions.
directory_activity_time: Choose valid start and end times, at most seven days apart. Times that are skipped or repeated by daylight saving cannot be used.
activities_audience_help: Select up to 20 groups. Group choices apply to new sessions; existing sessions keep their audience.
directory_activity_audience: Choose everyone or 1–20 active groups from this organization.
sessions_form_help: Schedule a future session. It keeps a copy of the activity details and audience.
sessions_edit_help: Change this future session’s time or location. Other sessions stay unchanged.
sessions_snapshot_help: These details and this audience were saved for this session.
sessions_past_help: The session’s schedule and details are read-only once it starts.
sessions_cancel_help: Cancel this session? Its details and cancellation reason will stay in the history.
directory_session_future: Choose a start time in the future. Sessions that have already started cannot be edited.
attendance_help: Record session attendance. Unmarked members are not counted as absent.
attendance_empty: No members match this roster view.
attendance_outside: Outside the current audience · saved record
attendance_reason_help: Required when changing saved attendance. Keep personal or sensitive circumstances out of the reason.
attendance_correct_help: Update saved attendance for the selected members? The previous values and your reason will stay in the history.
attendance_failed: {count} need review. The roster has been refreshed; review those members before trying again.
attendance_uncertain: The save is not confirmed. Retry this same request to check its result.
attendance_leave_help: This save has not been confirmed. It may already have reached the server. Retry to check the result, or leave and review the roster when you return.
attendance_not_started: Check-in opens when this session starts. Refresh the roster then.
attendance_cancelled: This session is cancelled. Attendance can only be viewed.
attendance_access: You do not have permission to manage this session’s attendance.
directory_attendance_not_started: Check-in is not open yet. Refresh when the session starts.
directory_attendance_cancelled: This session was cancelled. Its attendance is read-only.
directory_attendance_key_conflict: This request key was already used for a different save. Refresh and review the roster.
attendance_conflict: Changed since it was loaded. Review the latest status.
attendance_ineligible: Not currently eligible for a new attendance record.
directory_choose_members: Choose up to 50 active members. Members already in this group cannot be selected.
access_help: Assign volunteers to groups or activities and control attendance access.
access_attend_help: Allows recording and correcting attendance within the selected group or activity.
access_scope_help: A group assignment follows its current members. An activity assignment covers its audience; an activity for everyone includes all organization members.
access_revoke_help: Remove this volunteer’s permissions for this assignment? Attendance and audit history are preserved.
access_reduce_help: Remove the permissions you unchecked? New requests will use the reduced access. Existing records are preserved.
access_staff_change: Automatically revoked after a staff role/access change
access_leave_help: This save is unconfirmed and may have reached the server. Retry this form or review assignments before creating another grant.
directory_access_duplicate: This volunteer already has an active assignment for this target. Edit that assignment instead.
directory_access_volunteer: Choose a current volunteer in this organization.
manage_intro: Manage your organization and staff access.
manage_staff_help: Manage the people who help run your organization.
manage_invites_help: Invite organizers and manage pending staff invitations.
manage_access_help: Choose which groups and activities volunteers can manage.
manage_organization_help: View workspace details, timezone and your role.
profile_intro: Manage your account, language and device preferences.
notifications_help: Updates for this organization. Open an item to see the details.
notifications_empty: You’re all caught up. New updates will appear here.
push_help: Receive private, generic alerts on this device for updates across your organizations. Personal details stay inside Himmah.
push_enabled: Push notifications are enabled on this device.
push_disabled: Push notifications are off on this device.
push_unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. You can still read updates here.
push_ios: On iPhone or iPad, add Himmah to your Home Screen, then open the installed app to enable push notifications.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser or device settings, then try again.
push_service: Push notifications could not be updated. Check your connection and try again.
push_not_configured: Push notifications are temporarily unavailable. Your in-app notifications still work.
push_conflict: This device is linked to another account, or your account has reached the device limit. Disable push for the other account or device first.
push_disable_description: This device will stop receiving alerts. Your in-app notifications and other devices are unchanged.
push_all_description: Stop push alerts on every device signed in to this account. In-app notifications remain available.
push_device_hint: Each device needs permission separately. Delivery depends on your browser, connection and device settings.
push_alert: You have a new notification. Open Himmah to view it.
directory_game_not_due: This event is not due yet.
people_archive_description: Archiving keeps the contact and history but removes it from active lists. Restoring returns it to active lists.
people_remove_description: This detail will no longer be used. Its removal remains in the history.
people_discard_description: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
people_method_hint: Record this person’s own phone or email. Phone numbers need an international dialing code, such as +32.
people_name_hint: A name is enough. Other details are optional and no account is created.
people_conflict: This record changed, or the retry contains different details. Reload the record before trying again.
people_denied: This contact or organization is unavailable, or you do not have access.
people_unavailable: Contacts are not available for this organization yet.
people_invalid: Check the name and contact details. Phone numbers must include an international dialing code.
people_duplicate_method: This contact already has that detail.
people_signin: Sign in with a verified staff account to manage contacts.
people_group_restore_hint: The group will become active again. Previous memberships will stay ended.
people_group_archive_hint: This ends {count} active memberships and archives the group. Membership history is preserved.
people_end_membership_hint: This ends the current group membership. Previous participation and membership history are preserved. Enter the reason before confirming.
people_group_hint: Use groups to organize people. Contacts can belong to several groups.
people_add_members_hint: Select up to 50 contacts. Existing members are marked and cannot be added twice.
people_assignment_partial: Some contacts could not be added. Successful additions are saved. Remove and select the remaining contacts again to review their current details before retrying.
people_selection_limit: Select at most {limit} contacts at once.
people_reason_required: Enter a reason of up to 300 characters.
people_no_contact_groups: This contact has no group memberships.
people_group_assignment_hint: Choose a group for this contact. Existing memberships are marked.
people_relationship_scope_hint: Family relationships do not grant access, establish legal guardianship, or automatically decide whom staff should contact.
people_end_relationship_hint: The relationship will no longer be active. Its history remains available. Enter a reason before confirming.
people_relationship_selection_required: Choose another contact and a relationship type.
people_type_archive_hint: Archiving prevents new relationships using this type. Existing relationships and their saved labels remain unchanged. Restoring makes the type available again.
people_type_hint: Define directional roles and their inverse, or reciprocal roles such as siblings.
people_type_version_hint: Provide labels in all three languages. Edits apply to future relationships; existing relationships retain their saved labels. Direction and category cannot change after creation.
people_type_labels_required: Provide a role and inverse in English, Dutch and Turkish. For reciprocal types, the same label is used in both directions.
people_archived_reference: This record is archived. Restore it before making changes.
people_archive_groups_description: This archives the contact and ends {count} active group memberships. Contact details and history are preserved.
people_contact_restore_hint: The contact will become active again. Ended group memberships will not be restored automatically.
people_communication_hint: Assign communication explicitly. Family links do not establish contact responsibility or legal authority.
people_end_communication_hint: End this responsibility with a reason. Its history remains available.
people_no_usable_method: No usable contact method. Add details or designate another contact person.
people_missing_channels: Candidates without a usable allowed channel: {count}
people_routing_alternatives: Equally ranked options: {count}. Shown here: up to 3. View all responsibilities to review the others.
people_routine_direct: Use own details first for routine contact
people_emergency_direct: Allow own details as an emergency fallback
people_responsible_required: Choose a contact person and a priority from 1 to 99.
people_archive_communication_warning: Active contact responsibilities for other people will end: {count}. Restoring does not reactivate them.
access_capabilities: Enable at least one permission for this scope.
registration_settings_locked_help: Settings lock 30 minutes before start or when the session is cancelled.
registration_open_help: Drop-in session: registrations are optional. There is no expected attendance denominator.
registration_frozen: Original roster: {count} contacts · frozen at {time}. Later changes are recorded separately.
registration_freezes_at: The original expected roster freezes when check-in opens: {time}.
registration_scoped: You only see contacts within your current staff access.
registration_independent: A reservation does not mark attendance. Attendance remains available for walk-ins.
registration_policy_help: Choose optional drop-in or registration-required attendance. Settings lock 30 minutes before the session starts.
registration_add_help: Choose an eligible contact. Registration reserves a place without recording attendance.
registration_capacity_help: Leave empty for no limit. Capacity cannot be lower than the number of confirmed reservations.
registration_selection_required: Choose a contact and provide a reason for changes to a frozen roster.
registration_uncertain: The result is uncertain. Try again with this saved request before making another change.
directory_registration_key: This retry belongs to a different request. Reload to review the saved registration.
directory_registration_capacity: No reservation place is available, or the capacity is below the confirmed total. Refresh to see the latest availability.
directory_registration_closed: Registration is closed for this session.
directory_registration_locked: Registration settings are locked because check-in has opened.
directory_registration_ineligible: This contact is archived or outside the session audience.
directory_registration_reason: Provide a reason for this cancellation or roster amendment.
directory_registration_duplicate: This contact already has a confirmed reservation. Refresh the list.
registration_schedule_locked: The schedule is locked because check-in has opened for this registered session.
pricing_activity_help: Free by default. This price applies only to newly scheduled sessions.
pricing_session_help: This session inherits the activity price. Registration is optional unless separately required. Price locks after the first registration or charge.
pricing_locked: The session price is locked because registrations or charges already exist.
pricing_confirm: Registering reserves a place and creates a charge of {price}. This does not record a payment or attendance.
pricing_cancel_review: The charge is retained for review. No waiver or refund is recorded automatically.
directory_pricing_amount: Enter a price from EUR 0.01 to EUR 1,000,000 with at most two decimal places.
cash_collect_permission_help: Allows scoped balances and receipt collection. Does not grant attendance, refunds or receipt corrections.
cash_scoped: Balances cover only contacts within your collection access.
cash_reverse_help: Correct an incorrect cash entry. Its allocations are reversed and its full history is retained. This is not a cash refund.
cash_uncertain: The result is uncertain. Retry the saved request before recording this cash again.
cash_form_help: Choose the people this cash payment covers.
cash_closed: New cash cannot be collected for this cancelled or free session. Existing receipts remain available.
cash_confirm: Record {amount}: {allocated} allocated, {unallocated} unallocated. This does not record attendance.
cash_validation: Enter valid amounts and a receipt time, select up to 50 charges, and keep allocations within the cash received and outstanding balances.
directory_cash_key: This retry belongs to a different receipt. Review the saved cash before making another entry.
directory_cash_closed: Collection is closed for one of these charges. Review the current session and registrations.
directory_cash_allocation: The allocations exceed the cash received or a current outstanding balance. Refresh and review the amounts.
directory_cash_reason: Provide a reason for reversing this entry.
directory_cash_time: Use a valid receipt time that is not in the future.
billing_confirm_charge: Add {price} for {name} for this session. This does not create a reservation, mark attendance or record payment.
billing_charge_on_save: Saving adds the {price} session charge and records this cash together. No reservation is created.
billing_required_help: This session requires registration. Register the participant before charging.
billing_uncertain: The charge result is uncertain. Retry this saved request before adding another charge.
directory_billing_registration_required: Registration is required for this session. Register the participant first.
billing_new_charges: Also creates {price} in session charges. No reservation is created.
quick_cash_new_charge: This also adds the {amount} session fee. No registration is created.
quick_cash_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero and no more than {amount}.
attendance_add_help: Select contacts to add to attendance.
attendance_remove_help: Remove {name} from the present list? Their payments will be kept.
attendance_present_empty: No one is present yet. Add a participant to get started.
management_clear_confirm: Update {count} selected participant(s)? Their payment records will be cleared from active tracking. This does not record a cash refund.
management_scope: Payment totals cover the contacts you can manage.
insights_choose: Select an option to apply it. Archived records remain available.
insights_range: Choose valid dates, up to 366 days apart.
insights_empty: No started sessions match this period and these filters.
insights_balance_help: Current recorded charges and payments for sessions starting in this period. Includes charges for contacts no longer attending.
insights_group_cash_help: Applied cash received during this period for the selected group. Unallocated cash cannot be attributed to a group.
insights_cash_help: Recorded cash received during this period, including unallocated cash. This uses receipt dates, independently of session dates.
insights_definitions_help: Attendance counts current present contact/session records. First recorded means the first known presence in this organization; returning people have earlier recorded presence. Cancelled and future sessions are excluded. Archived contacts remain in history. Corrections update these reports.
insights_group_help: Groups use membership at session start. People in several groups appear in each group, so group totals must not be added together. No absence or attendance percentage is inferred.
directory_insights_range: Choose valid dates, up to 366 days apart.
directory_insights_filter: This activity or group is unavailable. Clear the filter or choose another.
dashboard_balance_note: Outstanding on recorded charges for sessions this month.
statistics_context_help: Averages use started sessions. Returning share describes attendees with an earlier recorded visit; it is not a retention rate.
statistics_comparison_help: Complete months compare with the complete previous month. Month-to-date compares the same days of the previous month, capped at its last day. Custom ranges compare the preceding equal-length period. Colors show direction, not service quality. Earlier session balances have had more time to be paid. pp means percentage points.
activities_delete_help: Permanently delete “{name}”? This removes {sessions} sessions, {attendance} attendance entries, {charges} charges and {receipts} payment records, including their history. Contacts and groups are kept. This cannot be undone and does not refund money. Archive instead to keep this history.
series_help: Choose your weekly schedule, then review the dates. Each session keeps its own attendance and payments.
series_edit_help: Review the affected dates. Topics, locations, registrations, attendance and payments stay with each session. Started and cancelled sessions are excluded.
series_bound: Plan 2–52 sessions, up to one year ahead of the first date.
series_uncertain: Your plan is kept for an exact retry. Retry before making another plan to avoid duplicates.
directory_series_limit: Choose 2–52 sessions within one year, and select at least one weekday.
series_price_help: Each session uses this price. Registration stays optional.
schedule_description: All current and upcoming sessions, in date order.
cancellation_help: Review the sessions and recorded cash. Their history stays intact.
cancellation_skipped: Started and cancelled sessions are excluded.
cancellation_money_review: Review charges and received cash. Nothing is refunded or waived automatically.
cancellation_confirm_help: Selected sessions: {count}. Confirmed registrations: {registrations}. Recorded cash: {money}. All records are retained; no refund or waiver is recorded.
cancellation_uncertain: The reviewed cancellation is kept for an exact retry. Retry before starting another cancellation.
follow_up_intro: Find contacts to follow up with, using recorded visits.
follow_up_since: No recorded visit since {date}. Oldest last visits first.
follow_up_never_help: These contacts have no recorded visits. Newly added contacts are included.
follow_up_definition: Only active contacts are shown. Visits use current recorded attendance at sessions that have started and were not cancelled, including archived activities. Missing records do not prove absence or disengagement. Open a contact for their details and Who to contact. No messages are sent automatically.
chart_interaction: Hover or tap a bar to inspect it. Choose a period for its recorded totals.
chart_comparison_help: Totals reflect current records. Changes are not a service-quality score.
learn_intro: Quizzes and tests, independently or linked to an activity.
learn_editor_intro: Create multiple-choice questions. Publishing preserves a fixed version.
learn_one_attempt: One submitted attempt initially. Staff can explicitly allow another, up to five in total. No countdown timer.
learn_clear_context: Remove links to activity and session
learn_correct_help: Select the circle beside the correct answer. Every question is worth one point.
learn_uncertain: The response was not received. Retry the same request before making another change.
learn_copy_help: Select and copy the link manually.
learn_assignment_warning: Individual links identify an assignment, not the person holding the device. Keep links private. Generating a new link replaces the previous one; no message is sent.
learn_links_ready: Links are ready. Copy them now; they are only shown here once. You can generate replacements later.
learn_not_available: This learning item is not accepting answers now. Previously saved submissions are preserved.
learn_empty: No learning items yet. Create your first quiz or test.
learn_publish_warning: Publish this draft as a fixed version? A new version closes answering on older versions and needs new participant links. Existing submissions and results are preserved.
learn_close_warning: This changes whether participants can answer. Submitted attempts and released results are retained; the configured availability dates still apply.
learn_release_warning: Participants with a submitted attempt will see their score, correct answers and explanations for this version. This cannot be undone.
learn_rotate_warning: This replaces the current open link and invalidates access through the old link, including guest sessions using it. Saved results are retained.
learn_guest_warning: Open participation uses unverified display names. A shared link cannot enforce one attempt per real person across devices. No contact is matched automatically.
learn_released: Results are available to participants who submitted.
learn_results_held: Submitted. Your score and feedback will appear when staff release the results.
learn_no_opening: Available immediately while answering is open.
learn_independent: Learning never changes attendance, registration or payments.
learn_revoke_warning: This person can no longer access the item. Their saved answers and submitted results remain in staff history.
learn_allow_warning: Allow one additional attempt for this participant? Previous submissions and scores are preserved.
learn_access_error: Unable to open this learning item
learn_access_help: The link may be invalid or revoked. Ask the organizer for access if needed.
learn_unanswered_count: {count} questions unanswered. You may go back or submit with these unanswered.
learn_submit_warning: Submitting is final for this attempt. Unanswered questions receive zero points.
learn_saved: Answers save when you select an option.
directory_learning_closed: Answering is closed or outside the availability dates. Refresh to see saved work.
directory_learning_attempt_limit: The attempt limit has been reached. Ask staff if another attempt is needed.
learn_staff_results_held: Results are withheld until you release them.
learn_conflict: This item changed. Your draft remains here. Reload the latest saved version before editing again; reloading discards unsaved changes.
learn_unpublished_changes: Draft changes are not live. Publish a new version when ready.
learn_wizard_remove_warning: Remove this question and its options from the draft?
learn_wizard_review_help: Check your details, questions and access settings. Saving keeps this as a draft; publishing remains a separate action.
learn_wizard_details_error: Enter a title of 2–160 characters and check the description.
learn_wizard_question_error: Complete question {number}: enter the question, fill every option and choose the correct answer.
learn_wizard_access_error: Check the availability dates. The deadline must follow the opening time; ambiguous local times are not accepted.
learn_display_name_help: Your display name is not linked to a contact record.
learn_quiz_invitation: Bring your curiosity. Let’s learn something new.
learn_quiz_finish_note: Every question is a chance to learn.
learn_contact_empty: No quizzes have been assigned to this contact.
learn_contact_no_matches: No assigned quizzes match your search.
learn_contact_identity_note: Only explicit contact assignments appear here. Guest display names are not matched to contacts.
live_host_intro: Invite a group and guide them through a published quiz.
live_publish_first: Publish the current quiz version before opening a room.
live_no_rooms: No live rooms yet. Open one to invite your group.
live_end_warning: This closes answering and ends the room for everyone. Only questions already shown count in the results. The room cannot be restarted.
live_qr_alt: Scan to join this live quiz
live_room_rules: Up to 200 guest places. Joining closes when you start. Questions are untimed; you decide when answers lock.
live_remove_warning: This participant loses room access. Their answers stay in history and are excluded from the active group summary.
live_join_intro: Enter the room code from your organizer.
live_code_hint: The code has 10 letters and numbers.
live_join_rules: Play at your organizer’s pace. You can change your answer until they lock the question.
live_anonymous_hint: Leave blank for a player number. This does not create an account or link to a contact.
live_join_closed: Joining is closed. If you already joined, use the same browser and room code to return.
live_wait_start: Your organizer will start the quiz.
live_thanks: Thanks for playing. Every question is a chance to learn.
live_wait_next: Wait for your organizer to continue.
live_wait_reveal: Wait for the answer to be revealed.
live_choose_hint: Choose an answer. You can change it while answers are open.
directory_live_revoked: Your access to this room has been removed.
directory_live_expired: This room has expired. Ask your organizer for a new code.
directory_live_closed: This room has ended or expired. Refresh to see its final state.
directory_live_started: The quiz has started. Joining is closed.
directory_live_locked: Answers are now locked. Refresh to continue.
directory_live_full: All 200 guest places in this room have been used.
directory_live_empty: Wait for at least one participant before starting.
directory_live_transition: The quiz has moved on. Refresh before continuing.
directory_live_unavailable: Publish the current quiz version before opening a room.
learn_insights_empty: Results will appear after the first submission.
learn_insights_method_text: Each assignment or guest entry counts once, using its latest submitted attempt. Earlier attempts and unfinished answers do not affect scores. A new attempt in progress can coexist with a completed result. Revoked links remain in historical counts. Live rooms are separate.
learn_insights_guest_note: Guest entries are browser credentials, not verified people. No completion percentage is available because shared-link viewers are unknown.
learn_insights_selection_hint: Tap a bar or choose a score to inspect its count.
learn_insights_scope: Summaries cover the whole selected version. Name search filters only the individual results below.
interface_request_unconfirmed: We could not confirm this request. Please try again.
interface_load_error: We could not load this information. Please try again.
interface_save_error: Saving could not be confirmed. Your changes are still here. Please try again.
follow_session_help: Choose your personal updates for this session.
follow_activity_help: Receive updates for current and future sessions in this activity.
follow_inherited: You currently follow the activity. Saving here sets preferences for this session only.
follow_device_help: Updates appear in Notifications. Push alerts need separate permission on your device.
follow_closed: Only active activities and upcoming sessions can be followed. You can still turn existing updates off.
follow_conflict: These preferences changed elsewhere. Load the latest version, then review and save your choices.
follow_review: Latest version loaded. Your selections are kept; review them before saving.
import_help: Upload a CSV, match its columns and review contacts before creating them.
import_file_help: CSV in UTF-8, up to 1 MB and 500 contacts. Your original file stays on this device.
import_file_error: Choose a valid UTF-8 CSV with a header, equal columns and 1–500 contact rows (maximum 1 MB).
import_format_help: Use a header row and comma, semicolon or tab separators. Names, email and phone are supported. Phone numbers need a country code, such as +32. Groups and other columns are not imported.
import_mapping_help: Choose each column once. Map a display name, or given and family names to build one. Unmapped columns are ignored.
import_mapping_error: Choose at least one name column and use each column only once.
import_invalid_rows: Check rows {rows}: a name is required; names must fit 120 characters, email must be valid and phone must include its country code. Fix the file or explicitly skip these rows.
import_duplicate_help: Possible duplicates are not selected. Select one only if it is a different person. Import creates new contacts; it never updates or merges existing ones.
import_review_changed: Contacts changed since your review. Check again and review the new selection before saving.
import_done_help: Selected contacts were created. No accounts, attendance or payments were added.
export_intro: Download contacts and reports as CSV.
export_contacts_help: Names and one primary email/phone per contact: preferred, otherwise the oldest active detail.
export_attendance_help: Current recorded presence at started, non-cancelled sessions in this period, with actual charge balances.
export_roster_help: Currently present contacts in this session, with recorded charge balances. Retained attendance is included if the session is cancelled.
export_balances_help: Recorded charges and effective payments for sessions starting in this period, including cancelled and future sessions.
export_cash_help: Effective recorded cash by receipt date. Reversals are excluded and allocation corrections are deducted.
export_insights_help: Uses the same participation and payment definitions as Insights.
export_session_scope: Includes this entire session; date filters do not apply.
export_format_help: UTF-8 CSV with comma separators, quoted fields and ISO dates. EUR amounts use a decimal point and two decimal places. Text that could be interpreted as a spreadsheet formula is protected with an apostrophe.
export_limits_help: A file contains at most 10,000 rows and 8 MB. If it is larger, narrow the filters; records are never silently cut off. Downloads are fresh snapshots and are not stored in Himmah.
export_groups_help: Group filters use current membership for contacts and membership at session start for attendance, balances and cash. Unallocated cash has no group and is blank when a group is selected.
export_invalid: Choose valid filters and a date range of at most 366 days.
export_limit: This export is too large. Narrow the date range or filters and try again. Nothing was truncated.
export_failed: The file could not be prepared. Your filters are still here; try again.
fields_intro: Choose the extra details your organization needs.
fields_form_help: Use a clear name. The type and choices cannot change after creation.
fields_required_help: Required when creating or editing a contact. Existing contacts are kept as they are.
fields_archive_help: Archiving hides this field from forms. Existing values stay on profiles and in exports.
fields_empty: No fields yet. Add only what you need.
fields_limit: Up to 50 fields per organization, including archived fields.
fields_import_help: Use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), numbers with a decimal point and exact choice labels. Yes/no accepts true/false or the exported language.
push_balance_help: Quiet hours follow each organization’s settings. Imminent cancellations can still alert you. Rapid edits are combined; relevant updates remain in your inbox.
fields_contact_help: Enter the contact details. Fields marked Required need a value.
fields_restore_help: This field will appear on forms again. Required fields must be filled when contacts are next edited.
org_settings_intro: Manage organization details and shared defaults.
org_settings_language_help: Default for new exports. Each person keeps their own interface language.
org_settings_timezone_help: Reports, organization quiet hours and new activity defaults use this timezone. Existing activities and sessions keep their saved timezones and times.
org_settings_timezone_choose: Search for a city or timezone, then choose one.
org_settings_quiet_enabled: Pause routine pushes during quiet hours
org_settings_quiet_help: Times use {timezone}. An imminent cancellation can still notify followers. Personal follows and device permissions stay unchanged.
org_settings_follow_quiet: Quiet hours: {start}–{end} in the organization’s timezone. Imminent cancellations can still alert you.
org_settings_no_quiet: This organization has no quiet hours. Routine alerts are still grouped and spaced apart.
org_settings_invalid: Check the details. Use a valid timezone, international phone number and different quiet-hour start/end times.
org_settings_updated: New settings are available. Reload them before saving. Your draft is kept until you choose to reload.
